what: Live probe of the pi-auth-plus v1 token bus from inside a real Pi-Bolt session (openai/gpt-6.1-terra), to decide whether a recount can be matched to Accordion's departing wire.
how: A probe extension subscribed to pi-auth-plus:v1:tokens:context and issued a nonce request on pi-auth-plus:v1:tokens:query after the run settled.
conclusion: No session, leaf, request or message identity is present, so a report cannot be proven to describe the same unfolded messages Accordion estimated.
The report's own count is a second chars-based estimate (source 'estimate'); the 'provider' variant is pi's context anchor, not this request's billed input.
Accordion's estimate of the same turn (14938) and pi-auth-plus's (14997) differ, confirming they are independent estimates of partially different projections.
Therefore no recount dial ships; the conservative prior and receipt-anchored k remain the only multipliers.
